summary: Q Drives mobile navigation E2E tested end-to-end on the public Expo web preview. Found & fixed a CRITICAL ReferenceError on Home screen (`loaded is not defined`) that was crashing the entire app immediately after KYC. After fix, all 20 requested navigation flows work: splash auto-redirect → login → OTP verify → 3-step KYC → home/tabs; bottom tabs (Home/Auctions/Sell/Watchlist/Profile) switch correctly with tab bar persisted; Home bell → /notifications; Featured auction card → /auction/[id]; auction back & bid buttons functional; Home search bar → Auctions tab; Auctions tab switcher (Live/Upcoming/Ended) works; Sell flow: reg lookup → AI estimate → launch auction → navigates to /auction/[new id]; Profile menu items (Notifications, Watchlist, Sign-out 2-tap) all navigate correctly; sign-out returns user to /login (auth guard verified).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER — Home screen referenced undeclared `loaded` variable at line 218 (`{!loaded ? (...) : ...}`), causing ReferenceError red-screen crash as soon as a dealer reached Home. The entire tab navigation was blocked by this. Added `loaded` state (useState(false)) and set it to true at end of `load()` callback.

`home-dealer-name` renders dealership_name preferentially over full_name (e.g. 'Test Motors' instead of 'Test Dealer'). Works as coded but the test request wording implies dealer name display — confirm this is the intended product choice.

issues: Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated, use boxShadow' console warnings across components (AuctionCard featCta, etc.). Non-blocking but will fail React Native 0.80+ upgrade. Cosmetic for web.
`props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` warning in ActivityTicker / LivePulse area.

action_items: Review the one-line state-init fix the tester applied to app/(tabs)/index.tsx (added `const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false)` and `setLoaded(true)` at end of `load()`). E1 may want a nicer 'skeleton while loading' UX than the current text-only skelCard.
Replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` (esp. featCta, AuctionCard) to silence warnings and future-proof for RN 0.80+.
Verify intended behaviour of `home-dealer-name` greeting — currently shows dealership_name first, falling back to full_name. If product expectation was 'Hi, <dealer first name>', swap the precedence.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/index.tsx was shipped with a ReferenceError to an undeclared `loaded` identifier — suggests the file was edited without running TypeScript check or a local web preview. Recommend adding `tsc --noEmit` or `expo lint` to CI before deploy.

KYC final step uses the same testID `kyc-next-button` for 'Continue' (steps 1-2) and 'Finish & enter Q Drives' (step 3). For clearer semantics and more robust testing consider `kyc-finish-button` on step 3.

useProtectedRoute hook exists in /app/frontend/src/useProtectedRoute.ts but is not imported anywhere (grep showed no callers) — auth guarding is actually performed inside `(tabs)/_layout.tsx` via `<Redirect>`. Either delete the hook or wire it into the root `_layout.tsx` to avoid dead code.
Sell flow successfully created two real listings in the DB during one test run (launch creates an auction per click). No cleanup / rate-limit on the public endpoint.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE of the Home red-screen: `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` was rewritten to declare `<AuctionCard /> mapping gated by !loaded ? <Skel /> : inventory.length === 0 ? <Empty /> : inventory.slice(0,5).map(...)` — but the `loaded` state variable was never declared. First render of Home therefore threw ReferenceError: loaded is not defined, which the Expo DevScreenErrorOverlay caught but the page was non-interactive. REPRODUCTION (pre-fix): login with any new phone → OTP 123456 → KYC 3 steps → redirect to /(tabs)/ → red overlay 'loaded is not defined'. MITIGATION: added `const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);` in Home component and `setLoaded(true);` at the end of the `load()` useCallback so the guard flips true after first successful fetch.
